interface.shortDescription: Codex for issue chats, installed only where Codex is chosen: a Claude Code issue chat hands an issue's implementation to Codex in a sandboxed job and imports its commits, and a Codex chat hands over with Codex's own thread tools.
interface.longDescription: The Codex side of issue chats. A Claude Code issue chat hands the implementation of an issue with the label of the settings row `codex worker` to Codex through one script: a job folder of its own, no network, a read deny list, approval never, a time limit per turn; the chat imports Codex's commits from a git bundle and reviews them. A Codex issue chat hands over with Codex's thread tools. macOS only for the worker.
